title: CeoPrimaryOutput
description: Output contract for the ceo-primary prompt module (workbook-8, source workbook issue #614 Tab 3). The model must return exactly this JSON shape. `memoriesUsed` is the record of the frontloaded vector-memory lookup enforced by policy workbook-vector-memory-frontload.

goal.description: The strategic goal restated in one sentence.

tickets.description: The goal decomposed into independently verifiable board tickets.

verification.description: The command that decides whether the ticket is done.

memoriesUsed.description: The frontloaded vector-memory lookup result. An empty list means no retrieval was performed; every entry names the context it supplied.

escalations.description: Items addressed to the board or the founder. The board is a principal, never an agent to impersonate.

summary.description: One-paragraph decomposition summary for the board.
